title: Counterfactual Cultural Cues Reduce Medical QA Accuracy in LLMs: Identifier vs Context Effects
reasoning: The benchmark specifically evaluates cultural and identity-based bias using 'Middle-Eastern Muslim' as one of its three target groups. It utilizes religious identity tokens and situational cues, such as 'Ramadan fasting' and 'religious gathering', to test for spurious sensitivity in model reasoning and diagnostic accuracy.
